top3.name: Claude
top3.bestAt: Careful reasoning, long-form writing, coding, nuanced analytical work. Generally considered the strongest prose writer and the most honest about what it doesn't know.
bullets: Defaults to Claude Sonnet 4.6 with ~15–40 messages per rolling 5-hour window
~200K-token effective context, file uploads (~20 files, 30 MB each)
Artifacts, Projects, Memory, web search, vision — all on the free tier
top3.uniqueFeature: Artifacts + Projects — a side-panel that renders React components, SVGs, interactive docs, and mini web apps live, plus persistent project workspaces.
top3.signup: Email, Google SSO, or Apple SSO. No credit card.

top3.name: ChatGPT
top3.bestAt: All-around generalist work, mature tooling, the widest third-party app/connector ecosystem, voice UX. Strongest for structured business tasks and custom workflows via GPTs.
bullets: GPT-5.3 Instant (~10 msgs / 5-hour window) + GPT-5.4 mini added Mar 17, 2026
Voice mode, image analysis, ~3 file uploads/day, memory, web browsing
Use (but not create) Custom GPTs — tens of thousands available free
top3.uniqueFeature: The GPT Store / Custom GPTs ecosystem plus the most mature voice conversation UX.
top3.signup: Email, Google, Microsoft, or Apple SSO. Phone verification sometimes required.

top3.name: Gemini
top3.bestAt: Multimodal work and Google ecosystem integration — images, video inputs, music, audio overviews, and Deep Research in one interface.
bullets: Gemini 2.5 Pro free (3.1 Pro is paid). ~30 prompts/day + per-feature caps
5 Deep Research reports/month, 20 image gens/day, Gemini Live voice
32K-token free context — the sharpest free-vs-paid divide of the Top 3
top3.uniqueFeature: Deep Research + native Google Workspace/Search integration — pulls from Gmail, Drive, Docs with live-cited research reports.

alternatives.name: DeepSeek
alternatives.bestAt: Frontier reasoning at zero cost. ~90% of GPT-5.4-class quality on math, code, and logic benchmarks — and the free web chat is essentially unlimited.
alternatives.free: No practical message cap; web search included; DeepThink extended reasoning.
alternatives.catch: Chinese-lab origin — some employers, schools, or regulated industries restrict use. UI less polished than Top 3.
alternatives.uniqueFeature: Genuinely unlimited frontier reasoning for free, plus open weights for self-hosting.

alternatives.name: Grok
alternatives.bestAt: Real-time information and social/news monitoring — the only chatbot that plugs directly into live X (Twitter) data.
alternatives.free: Grok 4 + Grok 4.1 Fast (2M-token context). ~10 prompts / 2-hour window.
alternatives.catch: 2-hour window cap is tight. Free tier shrinking through 2026. Voice/video iOS-favoring.
alternatives.uniqueFeature: Native real-time X integration — live trends, breaking-news sentiment, specific X threads in real time.
